title: Side Effects Associated with Emsculpt Neo
paragraphs: The most common side effect of Emsculpt Neo is a mild feeling of muscle soreness like you might feel after an intense workout. during Emsculpt Neo treatments, the supramaximal contractions that occur flush lactic acid out of the body, which relieves the feeling of soreness.
